scope: 10 heroes, 160 original/base HQ poses only; no signature sprites, other motion sheets or rendered camera observations are counted.

method.fileAccess: Read only. Native RGBA alpha was decoded with Pillow; no image pixels, metadata, importer settings or PPU were changed.
method.crop: Use integer originalRect from the Unity export; convert Unity bottom-left y to top-left PNG crop via imageHeight-y-height.
method.height: Inclusive first-to-last row containing ANY alpha >= threshold pixel in the exact frame, including detached equipment. No largest-component filtering.
method.worldUnits: Native alpha height / originalPPU from the exact Unity geometry export.

limitations: This is PNG/geometry analysis, not a Unity test pass. Targeted/full Unity re-execution is pending and must use its own new raw report.
Whole visible-art height includes hair, clothes and detached weapons; it is not anatomical body-height or pose-continuity approval.
The 160 HQ frames do not establish rendering, all camera directions, actual combat, other source sheets, Windows startup, performance or save preservation.
The initial failed full PlayMode raw report was accidentally overwritten; only the explicitly extracted summary and observed original SHA remain.
